summary: No fatal issue was found in the 300-image source-index trace. Real COCO GT, exact replay assertions, output counts, and reported statistics are internally consistent. Oracle readout, asymmetric matched cohorts, geometry confounding, missing matched controls, and incomplete raw-array sealing limit claims to exploratory diagnostics.
fresh_reviewer_unavailable_reason: The bounded parent assignment explicitly prohibited spawning any new subagent.

details: COCO dataset annotations provide GT; crowd is excluded from ordinary-instance and spatial denominators.
NMS return indices are replayed exactly, and raw coefficients and scaled boxes are asserted equal to captured outputs.
All 300 val images require exact coeff/boxes/detections/proto cache equality with maximum error zero.
YOLO weights are frozen; readouts and coefficient-oracle gradients use temporary tensors only.
Frozen-mechanism intervention source was audited, but no new intervention result directory was verified in this audit.
Stage and official rates use all 3635 non-crowd GT in the selected 300 images; pair outputs use 1174 same-class adjacent pairs.
No self-max or prediction-statistic normalization fraud was found.
Feature probes select at most one hashed pair per pair type per image and are not all-pair population estimates.
Val labels are used to fit within-image oracle readouts; these are not train-only-to-val generalization results.
Bootstrap intervals apply to the fixed dense-enriched exploratory image sample and are pointwise without multiple-comparison correction.
Main counts reconcile: 300 images, 3635 GT, 1174 pairs, 66960 feature rows, 159 skipped feature rows, and 300 witness rows.
The first train witness is incomplete and retained as failed; v2 completes 32 images, 380 GT, 106 pairs, and 6384 feature rows on the disclosed mounted-image scope.
High-group recomputation matches bbox75 0.7220812183, segm75 0.5304568528, score availability75 0.7982233503, and NMS availability75 0.7385786802.
Cached bbox50 and historical segm75 labels have zero per-GT disagreement with the new official summaries.
Root outputs and derived CSVs are hashed, but raw/*.npz lacks a per-file or aggregate manifest despite being used by 0.75-stage postprocessing.
All reported trace, pair-feasibility, feature-readout, and summary functions are called in the executed --features path.
No reported metric was found to depend on an uncalled function.
Minor dead items are anchors, seed_offset, and one unused summarizer import; they do not change results.
The 176-pair actual-A cohort requires only annotation A to be bbox50 matched; B need not be matched, and A/B is not symmetrized.
The stricter 167-pair cohort requires both bbox50 matches but still uses GT-selected pairs and pair-exclusive GT pixels.
All-eligible high proto oracle AUC is 0.9919029638 versus coordinate AUC 0.9613239765, so geometry is a strong control rather than a negligible confounder.
Checkerboard folds share image, instance, and receptive fields; category, area, distance, and contact geometry are not matched.
Proto and coordinate main AUCs do not vary across the three seeds because dimensions are at most 32; only higher-dimensional layers receive random projections and shuffled-label nulls vary.
Pair regions exclude each other and crowd but do not exclude overlap with third ordinary instances; the planned separate GT-overlap accounting is absent.
normalized_center_distance is asymmetric in annotation A and should not be used as a symmetric control without revision.
Official bbox and segmentation recovery and candidate availability use real dataset GT.
Ridge readout is explicitly a GT-informed within-image oracle probe.
Spatial-oracle coefficient directions are GT-derived diagnostics, not deployable predictions or AP upper bounds.
No model-generated or synthetic pseudo-GT was found.

unverified_items: No cross-family reviewer verdict was obtained.
No new frozen_mechanism_probe intervention outputs were audited.
Raw NPZ contents were not independently rehashed into a complete manifest.
Missing category/area/distance/contact matched controls were not implemented.
No full-dimensional readout or equal-capacity coordinate control was run.
No new method, three-model-seed training, or full-val5k confirmation was run.
